displayDescription: A locator lands on the IDEA peak, a linked A–IDEA–C terrain section opens in relief, then focus returns to the map as routes connect.
styleRenderer: Three.js 0.187.0 (WebGLRenderer, PerspectiveCamera, BufferGeometry heightfield, ShaderMaterial elevation ramp + contours, 3D section slice)
SVG overlay projected from the same 3D coordinates
audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, sound effects or narration.
limitations: Illustrative procedural terrain: four Gaussian hills stand in for real geographic data. The contours, routes, 3D slice and section profile all come from one shared elevation function and coordinate transform.

The 3D slice is lifted above the terrain so it is readable. It is a diagram device, not a physical cutaway; relief is exaggerated 1.2× in 3D, and the section card states its own vertical exaggeration.
The scale bar is accurate for the top-down map view; while the camera is tilted (about 1.0–2.2 s) it is only approximate.
Shading is a simple hillshade with fixed light. No physically based materials or shadows.
STYLE.json has no reviewed preview recipes, so the preview shows the main characteristic action.
Blender was not used, as instructed.
